description:
## Problem
From 0.6.0 the wheel and sdist leave out the four TPC-DI appendix SQL files (tpcdi_audit.sql, tpcdi_validation.sql, tpcdi_visibility_1.sql, tpcdi_visibility_2.sql), but the bundled benchbox/_binaries/tpc-di/NOTICE.txt (and _sources/tpc-di/NOTICE.txt) still says "The SQL files are distributed unmodified ... with the EULA and this legend" and lists their SHA-256 values. A user reading the installed NOTICE is told the files are present when they are not.

The planned fix appends a paragraph saying distributions omit the files and that the file statements describe the repository copies. It cannot land as a normal change: quality/comment-cleanup-scope.json pins the bundled NOTICE as a whole-file external notice, and the comment-policy commit hook refuses any byte change ("protected external notice blob changed"). docs/internal/comment-policy.md says a candidate notice must keep the pinned bytes identical to the base.

## Decision gate (owner)
Choose one: (a) approve changing the pin for these two NOTICE files through the soundness-review path, then append the paragraph; (b) leave NOTICE.txt unchanged and put the statement in a separate, unpinned file next to it (for example DISTRIBUTION.txt) that the NOTICE does not contradict; (c) accept the current wording for 0.6.0 and record why. Record the choice and its reason in this item before any change.

## Guardrails
Never bypass the commit hook (--no-verify) or edit the scope pin without the owner's choice recorded here. The legend text required by the TPC EULA stays byte-identical. Work in a linked worktree; ship through make pr-open and make pr-arm.
